div.span: Triage agent, 20 issues, three sessions per point, priced at list prices from the token counts the API reported; Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 at their default efforts (medium, high).
At 5% of turns, two pauses, of 7 and 32 minutes; at 10%, four pauses of 6 to 32 minutes. Fable 5.1 was not run at 5%, so its dashed lines go straight from 0% to 10%.
'Every turn' is a separate test with a 6-minute pause before each turn, so no line joins it to the 10% point.
With 45-minute pauses (a 5-issue subset, not plotted), the 1-hour cache cost least on all three models.
Sonnet 5.5's every-turn points average two sessions per setting: in the third keep-alive session, two keep-alive requests timed out and the cache expired.
A keep-alive request re-sends the same prompt every 4 minutes, timed from the previous request's start, with max_tokens 0 on Fable 5.1 and 1 on the other two.
With no pauses no keep-alive requests are sent, so the keep-alive and plain 5-minute points differ only by run-to-run noise.
